ctx.x: Well, naturally, they were playing the Blues for one thing, and I can't think of...whatever tunes they used to jam on. They used to play "China Boy" and those kind of things, you know, or "Liza" with the changes, and "Honeysuckle Rose" and all those kind of things that guys used to jam on in those days.
